name: convo_v2_chat_history
description: v2: read the history stored in a finished chat turn so the page can resume (only for the same session).

load.name: load_turn
load.description: Get Workflow: fetch that chat turn. Optional: a missing id just means found=false.

tasks.name: answer
tasks.description: Return the history only if the turn completed and belongs to this session.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.prev.response.body? // .prev.workflow? // .prev) as $p | ((($p | type) == "object") and ($p | .status) == "COMPLETED" and ($p | .input.sessionId) == .sessionId) as $ok | (if $ok then (($p | .output.history) // []) else [] end) as $h | {found: $ok, history: $h, sessionId: .sessionId}
